steps.en: Start the official container on a GPU host with a Hub model id and a weights volume
steps.zh: 在 GPU 主机上启动官方容器，给出 Hub 模型 id 和权重缓存卷

steps.en: Downloads the weights and starts one model shard per GPU plus the router
steps.zh: 下载权重，按 GPU 各起一个模型分片，再起 router

steps.en: Point clients at its HTTP routes
steps.zh: 让调用方打它的 HTTP 接口

steps.en: Queues requests and slots new ones into the running GPU batch as room frees up
steps.zh: 请求排队，一有空位就把新请求插进 GPU 上正在跑的批次

steps.en: Streams generated tokens back to each caller as they are produced
steps.zh: 生成一个字就推回给对应的调用方

value.en: One GPU box serves many concurrent callers through an OpenAI-compatible API without you writing a server
value.zh: 一台 GPU 机器同时服务很多调用方，接口兼容 OpenAI，服务器不用你自己写

sources: https://github.com/huggingface/text-generation-inference#architecture and README feature list (launcher, router, continuous batching, SSE token streaming, Messages API)
